name: Local service businesses
examples: Cleaning companies, repair services, salons, pet care, and other appointment-led businesses
digitalNeeds: Clear service pages, local search foundations, quote forms, reviews, and easy-to-use booking or contact flows.

name: Home services and trades
examples: HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, landscaping, painting, and construction
digitalNeeds: Service-area pages grounded in real operations, estimate requests, project galleries, and mobile-first calls to action.

name: Healthcare and clinics
examples: Dental, medical, therapy, allied-health, and private practices
digitalNeeds: Accessible service information, appointment enquiries, staff profiles, and careful handling of sensitive information.

name: Legal services
examples: Law firms, attorneys, mediators, and specialist practices
digitalNeeds: Practice-area content, attorney profiles, consultation requests, and clear disclaimers.

name: Accounting and financial services
examples: Accounting firms, bookkeepers, financial advisors, and fintech teams
digitalNeeds: Trust-building information, secure enquiry paths, client portals, and useful educational content.

name: Real estate and property
examples: Brokerages, agents, property managers, developers, and mortgage teams
digitalNeeds: Property discovery, search and filter tools, listing content, and enquiry workflows.

name: Retail and e-commerce
examples: Online stores, independent retailers, direct-to-consumer brands, and marketplaces
digitalNeeds: Product catalogs, checkout, inventory connections, customer accounts, and post-purchase communications.

name: Restaurants and food businesses
examples: Restaurants, cafes, caterers, food producers, and delivery brands
digitalNeeds: Menus, reservations or order enquiries, location details, and up-to-date hours and contact information.

name: Hospitality and travel
examples: Hotels, venues, tour operators, and travel services
digitalNeeds: Service and room details, availability enquiries, booking connections, and destination information.

name: Education and training
examples: Schools, tutors, training providers, coaches, and online course creators
digitalNeeds: Course catalogs, enrollment enquiries, learning portals, and clear schedules.

name: Manufacturing and distribution
examples: Manufacturers, wholesalers, suppliers, and industrial companies
digitalNeeds: Product specifications, quote requests, distributor information, and business-to-business catalogs.

name: Logistics and transportation
examples: Freight providers, delivery companies, fleet operators, and mobility services
digitalNeeds: Service-area details, quote and tracking integrations, customer portals, and operations dashboards.

name: Professional services and consulting
examples: Consultants, architects, engineers, recruiters, and research firms

name: Insurance
examples: Independent agencies, brokers, and insurtech businesses
digitalNeeds: Coverage explanations, quote requests, secure customer access, and educational resources.

name: Automotive
examples: Dealerships, repair shops, parts retailers, and vehicle services
digitalNeeds: Inventory or service catalogs, appointment requests, financing enquiries, and location information.

name: Beauty, fitness, and wellness
examples: Gyms, studios, spas, wellness practices, and personal-care brands
digitalNeeds: Class or service schedules, membership details, booking paths, and mobile-friendly updates.

name: Nonprofits and community organizations
examples: Charities, membership groups, foundations, and community programs
digitalNeeds: Accessible program information, donation journeys, volunteer signups, and impact reporting.

name: Startups and SaaS companies
examples: Software startups, B2B platforms, subscription products, and technology ventures
digitalNeeds: Product positioning, onboarding, dashboards, billing, integrations, and an MVP roadmap.

name: Agencies and franchises
examples: Marketing and creative agencies, multi-location operators, and franchise groups
digitalNeeds: Consistent brand systems, location content, team workflows, and lead routing.

name: Agriculture and food production
examples: Farms, agricultural suppliers, food processors, and agtech teams
digitalNeeds: Product and capability information, wholesale enquiries, seasonal updates, and customer portals.

name: Other business types
examples: Specialist, hybrid, and emerging business models
digitalNeeds: A discovery-led scope based on your customers, operations, compliance needs, and growth goals.
